entity.summary: Japanese centralized cryptocurrency exchange operated by BTCBOX Co. Ltd. After a full-service suspension beginning on 2026-01-29, BTCBOX partially resumed login and crypto-asset deposit access on 2026-08-03; crypto withdrawals, exchange trading, and easy-buy services remained unavailable.
entity.notes: Launch date is stored at month precision from exchange-profile sources. BTCBOX suspended all services on 2026-01-29. Its 2026-07-31 official notice set 2026-08-03 at 10:00 JST for the resumption of login and crypto-asset deposits, while crypto withdrawals, exchange trading, and easy-buy services remained suspended; Japanese-yen withdrawals were planned for 2026-08-10. HEI therefore classifies BTCBOX as limited rather than active or inactive. No death date or death reason is assigned.

events.title: BTCBOX began operating in Japan
events.description: BTCBOX began operating as a Japanese cryptocurrency exchange in March 2014.
events.notes: Month-level launch marker from exchange profiles and company materials.

events.title: BTCBOX suspended all services
events.description: BTCBOX suspended website and application access, account opening, crypto trading, Japanese-yen and crypto deposits and withdrawals, order functions, and transaction-history access from 2026-01-29 while conducting extended system and safety checks.
events.notes: The suspension was initially announced as maintenance and then extended without an end time. A July 2026 first-party update confirmed that the full-service suspension was still continuing.

events.title: BTCBOX partially resumed login and crypto deposits
events.description: BTCBOX's official reopening schedule made login and crypto-asset deposit services available from 10:00 JST on 2026-08-03, while crypto withdrawals, exchange trading, and easy-buy services remained suspended.
events.notes: This is a partial reopening rather than restoration of normal exchange operation. The operator scheduled Japanese-yen withdrawals for 2026-08-10 and the remaining services for sequential reopening from September after further safety checks.

evidence.title: BTCBOX exchange profile
evidence.notes: Exchange profile identifies BTCBOX as a Japan-based exchange launched in 2014.

evidence.title: BTCBOX company and service website
evidence.notes: Current first-party website confirms the operating exchange identity.

evidence.title: System maintenance and temporary suspension of all services
evidence.notes: First-party notice states that all website, application, account-opening, trading, fiat and crypto transfer, history, limit-order, and API functions would stop from 2026-01-29.

evidence.title: Continuation of the full-service suspension
evidence.notes: First-party update confirms that all services remained suspended as of 2026-07-23 while external specialists continued safety checks.

evidence.title: Partial service reopening schedule
evidence.notes: First-party notice sets 2026-08-03 at 10:00 JST for login and crypto-asset deposit resumption, while stating that crypto withdrawals, exchange trading, and easy-buy services remain unavailable.
